narrative: On the board. Daylight on Saturday's leaf. The king is still coming down. The chair is pushed in. No candle is lit. On the board. Three words in the right margin, smaller than the speech. The pen is put down. Nothing follows them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the leaf, wrote leave it, and put the pen down.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Leave it
